If you'd rather skip that, the sample inbox works fine. Anything else on your mind?
ok one more thing - does google use my emails to train you or like, to train AI in general?

Connecting doesn't hand your emails to Google for training. It just gives this app permission to read them. I honestly can't promise how Persona handles data behind the scenes, so it's worth checking its privacy policy.
